text: A non-Chinese citizen holding a valid foreign passport with good physical and mental health and excellent academic performanceComply with Chinese laws and regulations and school disciplineThe academic level must meet one of the following conditions: Fresh high school graduates recognized by the state shall obtain a high school graduation certificate recognized by the state before admission in the same year, otherwise the admission qualification is invalid. A high school diploma recognized by the state. Persons who have obtained a bachelor's degree. 4.18-35 years old 5.Applicants who are native English speakers, or who have provided evidence of two or more years of English-taught studies, may not provide evidence of English scores; Applicants whose mother tongue is not English must provide proof of IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 80 or above; Or pass the exam organized by the School of International Education of Southwestern University of Finance and Economics.
